turns.question: What was the median number of days from application to hire for candidates hired in September or October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median time-to-hire metric; the closest is Time to hire (days), which is an average and was 6.08 days for candidates hired 1 September to 31 October 2026. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
